content:
[L] high | right copilot panel vs composer: the Copilot panel column extends full height to the window bottom edge while the composer strip stops short of it, so the composer appears to terminate against the panel mid-screen instead of spanning a defined region — the right panel visually collides/overlaps the composer's right boundary with no separator.
[S] high | top-right header: the "Copilot" button and circular status dot float detached near the window edge, and the Copilot panel header's "Copilot" title text overlaps/collides with the sparkle icon and X button — clearly overlapping elements at top right.
[S] high | middle toolbar (Filters / Reset / Sync now): "Filters" label sits mid-row with Reset and Sync now pushed far right, leaving a large dead gap and no alignment with the search row above; the row reads as three unrelated floating controls.
[H] med | status/priority/state/tag control card: eight lowercase segmented buttons across four rows all at equal weight with no grouping headers, so "active/pending/closed/spam" competes with "new/investigating/…" and reads like a debug panel.
[H] med | conversation list rows: sender name, timestamp, subject, and "Unassigned"/"Closed" metadata all near-identical weight and size; no clear primary line vs metadata hierarchy.
[C] high | center reading pane: enormous empty white dead zone between the second list item and the bottom composer (~250px) with no content, while the composer and copilot panel are dense — crushed-vs-empty imbalance.
[S] med | sentiment chip duplication: a "sentiment: positive" chip floats alone below the properties card, and a duplicate green "sentiment: positive" chip appears again in the Signals card top-right — inconsistent treatment and placement.
[C] med | Suggested reply card: the purple card overflows its region vertically, colliding with the "Reply drafting needs a routed Draft role…" footnote text beneath it, which is itself truncated/cut at the panel bottom.
[L] med | right panel bottom text: "Reply drafting needs a routed Draft role (AI Center > Model-role routing)." wraps to a clipped line at the window bottom edge.
[S] med | composer label column: "To", "Cc", "Bcc" labels are inconsistently aligned — "To"'s value starts further right than the Cc/Bcc input boxes, and the Cc/Bcc inputs extend past the reply textarea's right edge, breaking the shared column grid.
[H] low | timestamp "2026-10-16" divider line: centered metadata divider uses near-invisible hairline with tiny text, mixing timeline metadata at equal prominence with message content.
[C] low | views rail: rail is fine but its counts (0/0/2) leave two dead rows of empty gray, contributing to the left column feeling sparse versus the dense right column.
[C] low | summary card: the last bullet repeats verbatim as a plain paragraph below the bulleted list ("How do I give them full access…") — duplicated content reads as a rendering bug.
[S] low | search row: search input, "#" button, and "Apply" button have inconsistent vertical alignment and the Apply button is heavy black while neighbors are ghost-gray — mismatched control treatments in one row.
VERDICT: unprofessional — overlapping panels, floating unaligned controls, duplicated content, and large dead zones throughout read as a prototype, not a product.
